skill.summary: Automation skill for Ceo Notify Agents.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ceo-notify-agents skill.

- Allows the CEO to send notifications to other Agents via shared memory files.
- Supports multiple trigger phrases in natural Chinese for flexible invocation.
- Notifications are written into dedicated log files per target Agent and an overall log.
- Ensures that notifications are indexed for future retrieval by Agents.
